headline: Adrian's 2-0 shakes up the top as Orest suffers double-digit beatdown
dek: Three entrants posted perfect weeks while two suffered 0-2 disasters. The standings remain tight at the top with Chris and Jordy deadlocked at 11 points, but Adrian's sweep has him lurking just three games back alongside Ben — who watched both his teams enjoy the week off.
takeaways: Head-to-head fever: five direct pool battles highlighted the week, with the home team prevailing in four of them
Defense dominated in Tampa — Adrian's Bucs pitched a complete shutout against Atlanta, allowing just 125 passing yards and forcing four interceptions
The week's blowouts came in bunches: Bills by 26, Steelers by 21, Jags by 35, and Bears by 17 — a combined margin of victory approaching 100 points

games.text:
Chris's Pack handled Taras's Panthers in the week's first head-to-head, with Jordan Love dissecting the Carolina secondary for 288 yards and three touchdowns on 30-of-41 passing. Christian Watson was the primary beneficiary, hauling in eight catches for 113 yards, while Josh Jacobs punched in a ground score to complement his 39 rushing yards. Bryce Young threw for 209 yards and a touchdown for the Panthers, and Chuba Hubbard added 81 yards and a score on the ground, but Carolina couldn't keep pace after falling behind early.

The win was crucial for Chris, who swept his week and maintains a share of the pool lead at 11 points. Taras remains mired at the bottom of the standings, now 0-7 with the Chargers and fading fast at 3 points overall. Chris faces a monster Sunday ahead with both teams in action — the Pack visit Adrian's Patriots while the Bills travel to Minnesota on Monday night.

Chris's Bills absolutely throttled Orest's Ravens in Buffalo, turning what looked like a competitive AFC matchup into a 26-point beatdown. Josh Allen tossed two touchdowns and 289 yards, James Cook III rumbled for 80 yards and a score on 21 carries, and Dalton Kincaid added 86 receiving yards and a touchdown. Baltimore couldn't get anything going offensively — backup quarterback J. Fagnano completed just 10-of-21 passes for 91 yards and an interception, and Derrick Henry's 53-yard, one-touchdown effort on the ground was the lone bright spot.

This was Chris's second win of a perfect 2-0 week, keeping him tied with Jordy at the top of the pool at 11 points. For Orest, it was the start of a miserable 0-2 showing that dropped him to 8 points and seventh place. The Bills get a primetime Monday night test at Minnesota in Week 9, while the Ravens host Matej's Jaguars on Thursday night in what shapes up as an early-week head-to-head.

Bill's Cowboys let one slip away in Dallas, falling 33-30 to the Cardinals in a game defined by Arizona's explosive rushing attack. Trey Allgeier gashed the Dallas defense for 147 yards and a touchdown on just 11 carries, while Gardner Minshew II efficiently picked apart the secondary with three touchdown passes on 17-of-23 passing. Dak Prescott threw for 195 yards and a score for the Cowboys, and Jaxon Williams added 56 yards on the ground, but Dallas couldn't overcome Allgeier's big day.

The loss was Bill's only blemish in a 1-1 week that still netted him a game, thanks to his Steelers' dominant showing. He sits fourth overall at 9 points but remains well within striking distance. The Cowboys head to Indianapolis on Sunday afternoon looking to bounce back against a beatable opponent.

Jordy's Lions held off Minnesota at home in a low-scoring defensive struggle, with Jahmyr Gibbs doing the heavy lifting on the ground. The Detroit running back carried 23 times for 153 yards and a touchdown, while Jared Goff stayed efficient with 176 yards and a touchdown on 18-of-25 passing. Jameson Williams hauled in the scoring strike, finishing with four catches for 70 yards. Kyler Murray threw for 210 yards and two touchdowns for the Vikings but also tossed an interception, and Minnesota couldn't find enough offense to overcome Gibbs's dominance.

The win was Jordy's first of two on the week, keeping him level with Chris at the top of the standings. The Lions travel to Miami on Sunday in what should be a bounce-back spot against a reeling Dolphins squad.

Bill's Steelers demolished Cleveland at Heinz Field, with Jaylen Warren carrying the offense on his back. The Pittsburgh running back gashed the Browns for 143 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries, doing the damage while Aaron Rodgers managed the game with 172 passing yards and an interception. Darius Washington caught three passes for 94 yards, providing the big-play element. Deshaun Watson threw for 324 yards for Cleveland but couldn't find the end zone, and the Browns managed just two field goals all afternoon.

This was the win that salvaged Bill's week after the Cowboys' stumble, getting him to 1-1 and keeping him at 9 points overall. The Steelers are on their bye in Week 9, so Bill will have to lean entirely on the Cowboys' road trip to Indianapolis.

Adrian's Buccaneers pitched a stunning shutout in Tampa, blanking Atlanta in a game that was all about defense and Bucky Irving. The Tampa running back absolutely demolished the Falcons' front seven, racking up 170 yards and a touchdown on 27 carries. Baker Mayfield attempted just three passes — none completed — as the Bucs leaned entirely on their ground game and a defensive unit that forced four interceptions from Michael Penix Jr. The Atlanta quarterback completed just 8-of-24 passes for 125 yards in one of the ugliest offensive performances of the season.

This was Adrian's first win en route to a perfect 2-0 week, and it was arguably the most dominant performance any pool team put up all week. The Bucs host the Bears on Sunday night in Week 9.

Matej's Jaguars absolutely obliterated Indianapolis at home, winning 42-7 in a game that was over before halftime. Trevor Lawrence needed just 14 pass attempts to rack up 210 yards and three touchdowns, while Bucky Tuten had a monster dual-threat day with 104 rushing yards and a touchdown plus two catches for 55 yards and another score. Daniel Jones threw two interceptions for the Colts and managed just 144 yards on 19-of-28 passing, and Indianapolis never threatened after falling behind early.

The blowout win was Matej's bright spot in an otherwise tough 1-1 week, keeping him at 7 points but still within reach of the middle of the pack. The Jaguars head to Baltimore on Thursday night for a critical head-to-head against Orest's Ravens.

Tymko's Rams took care of business in the Battle of Los Angeles, beating Taras's Chargers 24-9 in a head-to-head that was never really in doubt. Matthew Stafford threw for 157 yards and a touchdown, Blake Corum punched in a rushing score, and Puka Nacua dominated with 11 catches for 80 yards and a touchdown. Justin Herbert threw two interceptions for the Chargers and couldn't get the offense untracked despite 257 passing yards, and Los Angeles fell to a stunning 0-7 on the season.

The win was Tymko's lone bright spot in a 1-1 week, but it was a critical head-to-head point that keeps him at 9 overall and within striking distance of the leaders. Taras, meanwhile, continues his miserable campaign — the Chargers are now winless and his Panthers couldn't deliver either, leaving him in the pool's basement at just 3 points. Tymko's Rams travel to Washington on Sunday, while Taras's Chargers host Ben's Texans in another head-to-head.

Jordy's Broncos held off Tymko's Chiefs in Denver in the week's most entertaining head-to-head, with Bo Nix outdueling Patrick Mahomes in a high-scoring affair. Nix threw for 222 yards and two touchdowns, while Jaleel Coleman added 41 rushing yards and a touchdown plus four catches for 63 yards out of the backfield. Mahomes threw for 321 yards and three touchdowns in a losing effort, with Eric Johnson hauling in five catches for 128 yards and a score, but Kansas City couldn't overcome a late deficit.

This was Jordy's second win of a perfect 2-0 week, keeping him tied with Chris at 11 points atop the standings. For Tymko, it was the loss that marred his week, dropping him to 1-1 and leaving him at 9 points overall. Both entrants have all their chips on the table in Week 9 — Jordy's Broncos visit Taras's Panthers while his Lions go to Miami, and Tymko's Chiefs host the Jets while his Rams travel to Washington.

Adrian's Patriots held off Miami on the road, with Drake Maye delivering an efficient performance to secure the victory. The New England quarterback completed 16-of-20 passes for 199 yards and two touchdowns, while Rhamondre Stevenson added 82 rushing yards on 19 carries. Demario Douglas caught three passes for 76 yards and a score. Malik Willis threw for 211 yards and two touchdowns for the Dolphins but also tossed an interception, and Miami's ground game couldn't get going despite Omarion Gordon II's 69 yards on 19 carries.

This was Adrian's second win of a perfect 2-0 week, vaulting him up to 8 points and into a tie for fifth place alongside Ben. The Patriots host Chris's Packers on Sunday afternoon in what shapes up as a massive head-to-head between two entrants near the top of the standings.

Matej's Eagles stumbled in Washington, falling 27-10 in a game that was never particularly close. Jayden Daniels threw for 217 yards and a touchdown for the Commanders, while Riley White punched in a rushing score. Tanner McKee threw an interception for Philadelphia and managed just 212 yards on 23-of-34 passing, and the Eagles' offense sputtered all afternoon despite a solid effort from the running game.

The loss was Matej's second game in a 1-1 week that netted him a point but kept him stuck at 7 overall and in eighth place. The Eagles host the Giants on Sunday in a get-right spot against a beatable opponent.

Orest's Seahawks got steamrolled in Seattle, falling 34-17 to the Bears in a game that was never in doubt after Chicago's ground game took over. D'Andre Swift carried 27 times for 69 yards and three touchdowns, while Caleb Williams efficiently managed the game with 247 passing yards and a score. Sam Darnold threw for 188 yards and two touchdowns for Seattle, and Jaxon Smith-Njigba had a solid day with six catches for 118 yards and a score, but the Seahawks' defense couldn't slow down Swift.

This was Orest's second loss in a disastrous 0-2 week that dropped him to 8 points and seventh place overall. He's now in serious danger of falling out of contention if things don't turn around quickly. The Seahawks host Arizona on Sunday afternoon, while the Ravens get an early test on Thursday night against Matej's Jaguars in a critical head-to-head.

entrants.name: Adrian
entrants.text: Perfect week vaults Adrian into a tie for fifth at 8 points, just three games off the pace. The Bucs' shutout and the Patriots' road win were exactly what he needed. He faces two huge tests in Week 9 — the Patriots host Chris's Packers on Sunday afternoon in a head-to-head, while the Bucs travel to Chicago on Sunday night.

entrants.name: Chris
entrants.text: Chris remains tied atop the standings at 11 points after sweeping both his head-to-heads. The Pack's handling of Taras and the Bills' demolition of Orest keeps him level with Jordy. He gets both teams in action in Week 9 — the Pack visit Adrian's Patriots in a head-to-head Sunday afternoon, while the Bills take on Minnesota on Monday night.

entrants.name: Jordy
entrants.text: A perfect 2-0 keeps Jordy tied with Chris at the top at 11 points. The Lions' grind-it-out win and the Broncos' shootout victory over Tymko's Chiefs were both critical. Both teams play Sunday — the Lions travel to Miami, while the Broncos visit Taras's Panthers in a head-to-head.

entrants.name: Bill
entrants.text: The Cowboys' loss to Arizona stung, but the Steelers' beatdown of Cleveland salvaged the week. Bill stays at 9 points in fourth place. The Cowboys travel to Indianapolis on Sunday, while the Steelers are on their bye.

entrants.name: Matej
entrants.text: The Jaguars' 35-point demolition of Indianapolis was beautiful, but the Eagles' stumble in Washington keeps Matej stuck at 7 points in eighth. The Jaguars face Orest's Ravens on Thursday night in a head-to-head, while the Eagles host the Giants on Sunday.

entrants.name: Tymko
entrants.text: The Rams' head-to-head win over Taras's Chargers was nice, but losing to Jordy's Broncos hurts. Tymko sits at 9 points in third. The Chiefs host the Jets on Sunday, while the Rams travel to Washington.

entrants.name: Ben
entrants.text: Both teams on their bye means Ben had his feet up all week, still sitting at 8 points in a tie for fifth. He finally gets both teams back in action in Week 9 — the Texans travel to face Taras's Chargers in a head-to-head, while the Niners host the Raiders on Sunday afternoon.

entrants.name: Orest
entrants.text: A brutal 0-2 drops Orest to 8 points and seventh place after the Ravens got steamrolled in Buffalo and the Seahawks couldn't slow down Chicago's ground game. He needs to right the ship quickly — the Ravens host Matej's Jaguars on Thursday night in a head-to-head, while the Seahawks get Arizona on Sunday afternoon.

entrants.name: Taras
entrants.text: Another 0-2 keeps Taras buried at the bottom with just 3 points. The Panthers fell to Chris's Packers and the Chargers dropped to 0-7 after losing to Tymko's Rams. Week 9 brings two more head-to-heads — the Panthers host Jordy's Broncos, while the Chargers face Ben's Texans on Sunday afternoon.

ahead: Week 9 kicks off Thursday night with a critical head-to-head — Matej's Jaguars visit Orest's Ravens at 8:15 PM ET.

Sunday brings four more head-to-heads: Jordy's Broncos at Taras's Panthers, Ben's Texans at Taras's Chargers, and Chris's Packers at Adrian's Patriots all in afternoon windows, with Adrian's Bucs visiting Chicago on Sunday night.
Chris's Bills close out the week with a Monday night trip to Minnesota.
